rationale: The two are identical from the 11-digit handling onward. They differ only in cleaning. B validates against an explicit whitelist of permitted characters and then keeps only the digits, which is direct and easy to read. A strips a set of characters it names `allowed`, which is misleading because these are the characters being removed. It then checks the remainder with str.isdigit(), which accepts non-ASCII digit characters such as superscripts, so odd input can slip past validation and break later. B's whitelist rejects such characters up front. B is slightly clearer and more robust.
